authority: original synthetic PNG fixtures and controlled fake provider executables only; no user media or source replacement

checks.evidence: All targets passed, including 8 synthetic candidate-production integration tests and 10 candidate artifact unit tests; one preexisting scheduled filesystem stress test ignored.
16 generated synthetic PNG files and the versioned index match.
Offline exact-version Zensical build found no issues.
Fake OxiPNG v10.2.1 consumed stdin and returned an original corpus PNG; CLI committed a 3-byte encoded reduction, inspected and recovered the artifact, and left source bytes unchanged.

limitations: The controlled fake executables test the OptiFlow process boundary, not OxiPNG's own optimization algorithm. No OxiPNG executable was installed locally; its source build was unavailable offline because the image dependency was absent from the cache.
Provider RSS and private workdir disk usage are unmeasured; the runner kills the direct child rather than a complete process tree.
Complete binary hashes before and after invocation do not eliminate a concurrent executable path-swap race or authenticate the binary's publisher.
Rust 1.85 MSRV, native macOS, disposable external volumes, and hosted CI were not checked for this candidate change.
The existing scheduled filesystem stress test remained ignored; encoded logical reduction does not prove reclaimed physical space.
